auditPolicy.activationRule: A city is ready only when every visible plate has a unique human place name and every grouping is exact-ID, connected and semantically coherent.
auditPolicy.suffixRule: Dissolve an Arabic suffix only when every cell shares the exact same base label and the official polygons form a connected graph.
auditPolicy.genericRule: A generic, directional, station or activity label is retained only by exact-ID accept citing IGN/INSEE and dated Guide Alpha review.
auditPolicy.technicalRule: Opaque inventories require exact-ID human renames supported by IGN named-road coordinates strictly contained in each exact IRIS. Nearest is forbidden.
auditPolicy.geometryAdjacency: Connected suffix families are verified from shared official WFS boundary vertices at eight decimal places.
auditPolicy.strictToponymRule: Every technical rename records an official IGN coordinate strictly inside the exact IRIS and strictContainmentVerified=true.
